title: Now card: tabs are real pages, chat on the right

set.request: Can you put everything on this page into a tab system? Like the, so the now card, can we make it without padding, make it full bleed and use like, kind of tiny top tabs to switch between different sections.
steps: tabs layout in card.js, opt-in by a layout line
route the tab in the URL
append the layout line to the Now card
chat back to a right sidebar, out of the tabs
set.outcome:
**Each tab on the Now card is now a real page with its own address, and the chat stays on the right.**
